passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng chī zǎo fàn。
wǒ hē niú nǎi， chī miàn bāo。

phrases.en: I have an egg and fruit.
phrases.py: wǒ chī yí gè jī dàn hé shuǐ guǒ。
zǎo fàn gěi wǒ néng liàng。
zhè shì jiàn kāng de kāi shǐ。
rán hòu wǒ qù shàng xué。

phrases.en: A hungry morning needs a real breakfast.
phrases.ko: 배고픈 아침에는 제대로 된 아침 식사가 필요해요.
phrases.zh: 饥饿的早上需要一顿真正的早饭。
phrases.py: jī è de zǎo shàng xū yào yī dùn zhēn zhèng de zǎo fàn。

phrases.en: Milk, bread, an egg, and fruit are enough.
phrases.zh: 牛奶、面包、一个鸡蛋和水果就够了。
phrases.py: niú nǎi、 miàn bāo、 yí gè jī dàn hé shuǐ guǒ jiù gòu le。

phrases.en: This healthy meal gives me energy for school.
phrases.ko: 이 건강한 식사는 학교 갈 힘을 줘요.
phrases.zh: 这顿健康的饭给我上学的能量。
phrases.py: zhè dùn jiàn kāng de fàn gěi wǒ shàng xué de néng liàng。

phrases.en: I do not skip breakfast before school.
phrases.ko: 나는 학교 가기 전에 아침 식사를 거르지 않아요.
phrases.zh: 上学前我不会不吃早饭。
phrases.py: shàng xué qián wǒ bú huì bù chī zǎo fàn。

full_passage_lines.en: I have an egg and fruit.
A hungry morning needs a real breakfast.
full_passage_lines.ko: 배고픈 아침에는 제대로 된 아침 식사가 필요해요.

full_passage_lines.en: Milk, bread, an egg, and fruit are enough.
This healthy meal gives me energy for school.
full_passage_lines.ko: 이 건강한 식사는 학교 갈 힘을 줘요.

full_passage_lines.en: I do not skip breakfast before school.
full_passage_lines.ko: 나는 학교 가기 전에 아침 식사를 거르지 않아요.

full_passage_spoken: I eat breakfast every morning. I am hungry. I have milk and bread. I have an egg and fruit. Breakfast gives me energy. It is a healthy start. Then I go to school. A hungry morning needs a real breakfast. Milk, bread, an egg, and fruit are enough. This healthy meal gives me energy for school. I do not skip breakfast before school.
full_passage_zh: 我每天早上吃早饭。我饿了。我喝牛奶，吃面包。我吃一个鸡蛋和水果。早饭给我能量。这是健康的开始。然后我去上学。饥饿的早上需要一顿真正的早饭。牛奶、面包、一个鸡蛋和水果就够了。这顿健康的饭给我上学的能量。上学前我不会不吃早饭。
full_passage_pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng chī zǎo fàn。 wǒ è le。 wǒ hē niú nǎi， chī miàn bāo。 wǒ chī yí gè jī dàn hé shuǐ guǒ。 zǎo fàn gěi wǒ néng liàng。 zhè shì jiàn kāng de kāi shǐ。 rán hòu wǒ qù shàng xué。 jī è de zǎo shàng xū yào yī dùn zhēn zhèng de zǎo fàn。 niú nǎi、 miàn bāo、 yí gè jī dàn hé shuǐ guǒ jiù gòu le。 zhè dùn jiàn kāng de fàn gěi wǒ shàng xué de néng liàng。 shàng xué qián wǒ bú huì bù chī zǎo fàn。
